question: Consider a system of two concentric conducting spherical shells. The inner shell of radius $r$ carries a charge $+q$ and the outer shell of radius $R$ carries a charge $+Q$. Analyze the potential difference $\Delta V$ between the shells. If the outer shell is now grounded (potential becomes zero), evaluate the new potential difference between the inner and outer shells.

options.C: The potential difference remains exactly the same, as it depends only on the inner charge $q$.
options.D: The potential difference increases because the outer charge changes.
